description: Implementation of HttpBasicStream class handling HTTP basic stream operations including request registration, stream initialization, request sending, response reading, connection management, and SSL info retrieval within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HttpBasicStream
classes.description: A class managing HTTP basic stream operations, including request registration, stream initialization, request sending, response handling, connection reuse, SSL info retrieval, and connection management within Chromium's network stack.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers an HTTP request info object for the stream.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream, optionally sending early data, with specified priority and logging, and confirms handshake if needed.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request with specified headers and handles response.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads response body asynchronously.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, optionally making the connection not reusable.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Creates a new stream for authentication purposes.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully received.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Checks if the connection was reused.

methods.name: SetConnectionReused
methods.description: Marks the connection as reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Determines if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the connection.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Indicates if alternative service info is available (returns false).

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL connection information.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL certificate request info.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the remote endpoint address.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Starts draining the response body.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the request priority (not implemented).

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for request headers.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases for the connection.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Returns accept-CH via ALPS (empty).

methods.name: OnHandshakeConfirmed
methods.description: Callback invoked upon handshake confirmation, records timing.
